description: The line plot illustrates the performance, measured as Micro F1 (%), of four different methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, a gray-shaded method (likely a baseline or control, though unlabeled in the legend), and SemEval—across four levels of sample generation (K=8, K=16, K=32, K=64). The x-axis, labeled “Number of Samples Generated,” is categorical, with four discrete values: K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64, evenly spaced. The y-axis, labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, is linear, ranging from 20 to 55 with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The blue line with circle markers (TACRED) starts at approximately 23% at K=8, rises to 28% at K=16, peaks at 30.5% at K=32, and slightly declines to 29.5% at K=64. The orange line with triangle markers (TACRED-Revisit) begins at 23.5% at K=8, increases to 29.5% at K=16, reaches 31% at K=32, and drops slightly to 30% at K=64. The green line with diamond markers (gray-shaded legend entry, possibly a third method or variant) starts at 35% at K=8, rises to 40.5% at K=16, jumps to 50.5% at K=32, and then decreases to 48% at K=64. The red line with square markers (SemEval) begins at 42% at K=8, increases steadily to 45% at K=16, 47.5% at K=32, and peaks at 51.5% at K=64. All lines show generally increasing trends, with the green and red lines achieving the highest performance overall, while the blue and orange lines remain below 32%.
